profile.summary: Guillermo is a backend technical lead with a strong focus on building microservice architecture that is scalable, resilient, and cost-efficient. He has a wealth of experience in backend technologies and has a track record of successfully leading and mentoring teams of developers. Guillermo is skilled at identifying and troubleshooting issues in complex systems and has excellent communication skills, making him an asset to any organization.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech Lead overlooking the team’s architecture, technical vision, technical road map and engineering quality.

Identity/People/Enterprise Technology:
-Propose plan to replace 3rd party identity provider to improve platform reliability, reduce support cost by +$1M/year and reduce risk on a single point of failure.
-Manage relationships with an external vendor to generate a multi-year cost estimate.

Notifications:
-Coach team members by providing feedback and guidance on technologies used, design of systems and project execution.
-Unblock team’s execution by providing troubleshooting and technical support.
-Define Notifications Team technical vision to build a loosely coupled and cost efficient platform.
-Proposed project to reduce platform on-board effort from 1 week to a few hours.
-Reduce the number of clicks for agents to manage notification settings by implementing a backend system that supports multi-level settings configuration.
-Eliminate DB timeouts and reduce operational cost by 40% by transferring sent notifications to long-term storage.
-Reduce operational cost by 20% by dropping unsendable notifications.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Designed, developed, tested and maintained features for Windows OS/Power Apps.

Power Apps: 
-Updated PowerApps licensing model to support new premium features.
-Provided performance improvement of apps startup for previously run apps by using cached information of apps to avoid unnecessary network calls.
-Created performance improvement of apps startup for apps running in SharePoint by implementing an API that allows SharePoint service to push data directly into PowerApps.

Windows Maps UWP Control:
-Analyze performance of Windows Map control and propose a plan of action to improve startup time.
-Enabled Windows Map control for all devices: HoloLens, Xbox, Raspberry Pi 2, Desktop and Phone.
-Designed, implemented and maintained public APIs (MapElementClick, MapElementPointerEntered and MapElementPointerExited, MapBillboard) for Windows Map control.

Reading List:
-Developed storage layer for Windows 8.1 OS pre-installed app Reading List.

Windows OS:
-Designed, implemented and patented solution to enhance the visual appeal of the copy/paste progress chart for Windows OS.

projects.title: Holoflight - Hackaton project
projects.description: What if you could pilot a drone with head movement and voice, all while sitting on your couch in the comfort of your home or office? With HoloFlight, that fantasy can be reality. Developed for HoloLens using Windows Holographic, HoloFlight allows you to control drones (yes, plural) and experience real time feedback using mixed reality with map overlay data. The controls are integrated into head motions and voice control by the user so you always feel as if you’re in the pilot’s seat.

patents.title: Operation chart rescaling
patents.description: Dynamically rescale the chart of an operation (i.e. file copy) depending on the latest reported value.
